memory.torch_scope: Allocator allocated/reserved and peak allocated bytes; not driver-wide dedicated VRAM. Snapshot after acceptance, not complete-process peak.
memory.process_scope: Owned Windows worker processes during synthetic CLI acceptance; RSS may include shared pages, private bytes are committed address space, not resident RAM.

lifecycle.scope: Interrupted run cannot qualify crash recovery or idle unload; resumed lifecycle evidence must be recorded separately.
